windows.basis: Goal creation timestamp through first prospective mapping window; excludes earlier read-only next-step assessment.

windows.scope: Source extent/crop/panel review,metadata preparation and routing setup;elapsed window is diagnostic,not measured human active time.

Observed assistant window includes approval/tool waits,OCR worker lifespan and preparation of audit/report scripts. It is not active recognition time;successful client inference and failed server compute are separately recorded.

Source correction and independent physical-row/label counting,including four bounded crop-repair inferences,tool/approval waits and source seam diagnostics. Elapsed window is not active human review or causal engine cost.
Native export,independent validation/rebuild and validator/report recovery;no new OCR in this window.

policy: Observed usage by response completion timestamp in [start,end). A boundary-straddling response is attributed wholly to its completion window. Cached/write input and reasoning output are subsets; do not add them twice. No observed records means unknown, not free work. Missing or delayed usage may require a later audit. Elapsed windows include tool waits. These observations are not a bill or causal engine savings estimate.
coverage_note: Between-window records remain visible as unattributed overhead. Span elapsed includes gaps and is not active correction time. Records outside the span are excluded. The last report/commit response may need the next audit.
limitation: Prospective assistant windows include preparation, source inspection, OCR/tool waits, correction, export/recovery and reporting. Initial goal/setup before preparation01 and later response tail require explicit overhead accounting; this is no causal engine comparison.
